stories.title: Oklahoma AD questions Ole Miss effort; decision to play Sunday 'inexplicable'
stories.summary: AD Roger Denny took aim at the SEC and Ole Miss about Oklahoma's game being moved to Sunday, calling it an "inexplicable" situation that "unfairly burdens" the Sooners.

stories.title: Buckeyes' Smith continues record haul, adds Big Ten career receiving mark
stories.summary: Ohio State wide receiver Jeremiah Smith broke yet another record, eclipsing the Big Ten mark for career receiving yards during the first half vs. Northwestern.

stories.title: 2027 UGA football commit dies following 'sudden medical emergency'
stories.summary: Georgia football commit, three-star defensive lineman Marcellus Young Casario died Friday after experiencing a "sudden medical emergency," according to his high school.

stories.title: Clemson QB Reynolds exits early with leg injury after slide
stories.summary: Clemson quarterback Tait Reynolds was knocked out of the Tigers' game against Georgia Tech on Saturday after injuring his knee on a run play.

stories.title: Sources: Vikings made initial Cousins trade call before MNF meltdown
stories.summary: The Vikings initially reached out to the Raiders about a Kirk Cousins trade before their MNF game against the Bills, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.
